title: C4: Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus
authors: C. Raffel, N. Shazeer, A. Roberts, K. Lee, S. Narang, et al. (9 authors)
before: Web-scale corpora were either proprietary or raw, unfiltered crawl.
problem: Common Crawl is mostly boilerplate, menus and noise, and nobody had published a cleaned version.
breakthrough: A documented cleaning pipeline over Common Crawl, released openly at hundreds of gigabytes.
why: The first open, reusable web corpus, which made independent replication of large pretraining possible.
next: The Pile, RefinedWeb, Dolma and FineWeb all iterate on its filtering.
inherits: The public web corpus as shared infrastructure.
